englishTitle: On the Eighth Centenary of the Independence of Portugal
addressee: To the Venerable Brother, the Patriarch of Lisbon, the Archbishops, Bishops and other Ordinanes of Portugal and its overseas possessions, in Peace and Communion with the Apostolic See.
rawClosingDate: Given at Rome, at St. Peter’s, June 13, the feast of St. Anthony, 1940, in the second year of Our Pontificate.
